sourceCard.name: Dispel Magic
sourceCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
sourceCard.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

availableAction: Must be demonstrated at actual event; none added here
target: One ongoing spell effect actually perceived

arithmeticControls.expected: success if all admission/activation prerequisites hold

recharge: 2 after paid activation; ticks only actual regular STARTs 2→1→0
perceptionQualification: Perceiving ordinary walls or knowing Fortress exists is not by itself a proven perception of the ongoing magical effect. Bind actual visible-effect/aura/detection source and its own range/time/activation if used.
